_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all projects. Add/reorder a project here and it updates the homepage grid + (later) generates its case-study page. Fields marked TODO are facts I should not invent — fill them in and they'll render automatically. Images live in /assets/images/ (see IMAGE-MAP.md); reference by filename only. `category` (residential | hospitality | retail) drives the homepage gallery filter. ORDER MATTERS: tiles render on the homepage 'All' view in exactly this array order (fixed manual order — no auto category mixing). Set `hideFromAll: true` to keep a project OUT of the 'All' view while still showing under its category filter (e.g. Bulgari & Brunello Cucinelli show only under Retail).
